_note: MODEL FILE for the Visual Studio (files starting with _ are never used on a real page; the Studio may render it to test the compositions). One file per page: src/media/<slug>.json with up to three blocks — hero (photo-hero), route (route-map), cost (cost-ladder). Photos: only files listed in hf/photos/CREDITS.md, captioned as a place only if that row allows it. Route lat/lon and day numbers come from research/pages/<slug>.md 'Media notes' (the figures below are the model's own, for shape). Prices: a 'price' prints 'from US$…' and must be in data/prices.json 'allowed'; everything else is words only.

hero._fields: kicker ≤ 28 chars, CAPITALS. scenes: 3–5 photos; kind = tilt (portrait, 1920 wide, vertical pan) | land (landscape, 2112 wide, scale + x pan); mirror only if CREDITS.md allows; t = [start, end] seconds (optional: scenes tile the 14 s loop with 0.6 s cross-fades); from/to = GSAP props (optional: gentle default pans). steps: 3–5 captions, CAPITALS, ≤ 18 characters, one per beat (14 s / n). The hero keeps all text in the right 55% of the frame; the Suzu wordmark sits bottom-right.

route._fields: title (CAPITALS, short), sub (one line), bounds = "auto" (zoom to the stops) or [lon0, lon1, lat0, lat1] (omit for all-India), dur (s), stops 3–9 in travel order: name, sub (one or two words), day ('Day 1–2'), lat, lon. The map has no outline and no boundary lines — graticule, stops and the route line only.
route.title: INDIA · 14 DAYS
route.sub: Golden Triangle, then the Himachal hills

cost._fields: kicker, title, items 3–7 (bottom rung first): label ≤ 26 chars, sub ≤ 60 chars, optional price (must be in data/prices.json allowed; prints 'from US$…'; items without a price show 'included', or the optional 'tag' word instead, e.g. 'optional' / 'your own' — never call an extra 'included'). end = one closing line (words).
cost.title: One quote, few surprises

items.label: Private car + driver
items.sub: fuel, tolls, parking and the driver's stay

items.label: Breakfast every day
items.sub: other meals as you like, where you like

items.label: A priced rung (model)
items.sub: price must be in data/prices.json allowed

cost.end: Flights, visa, entry tickets and tips are extra · exact quote on request
